spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact getStats() method on a real session and compares the result against all 13 WebTransportConnectionStats + 4 WebTransportDatagramStats members in spec order, distinguishing absent from zero.

interactive.rationale: Connect, call-again and close controls; allowPooling select; member table and raw JSON fill only from real results.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises inventory, stability invariant and pooled-stat column; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-session, unsupported build, malformed hash, post-close call and the member-stability invariant; the allowPooling=true path was not observed with a second pooled session.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776 and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Is the observation route for stats-dictionary-has-datagrams and member-exposure-stable-per-session manual assertions; getstats-method passes with the flag.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features against a real local Deno 2.9.8 QUIC/HTTP3 echo server (serverCertificateHashes), against the unreachable default public echo server, and without the flag. Local session: 7 members exposed (smoothedRtt, rttVariation, minRtt, estimatedSendRate, datagrams.droppedIncoming/expiredOutgoing/lostOutgoing), stable across calls, still resolving after close; default endpoint: real 'Opening handshake failed' surfaced with diagnosis; no flag: probe reports getStats undefined.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts surface present/missing, resolved, no-session reported and member-set stability.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only via kit.css; buttons pair background and color; status colours use emerald-dark and rose.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native controls, polite live regions for results, focus-visible outlines, named scroll regions for tables.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 0px horizontal overflow, single-column stages, 44px buttons/inputs; deno task responsive-check ok on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Observe a pooled session's member set
openQuestions.detail: Open two allowPooling sessions to the same origin and confirm only pooled connection stats appear.

openQuestions.title: Re-check exposed members on Chrome 159 stable
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 153 + flag exposed 7 members; confirm whether 159 adds atSendCapacity or expiredIncoming.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results through polite live regions; keep controls native with visible labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every result <output> is aria-live=polite; all inputs/selects have <label for>; buttons use visible text; focus-visible outlines from kit.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap tables in a focusable role=region with an accessible name (aria-labelledby the caption) and let the wrapper scroll instead of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All tables sit in .table-wrap with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby=<caption id>; 0px page overflow measured at 360x740.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form inputs labels validation for URL and number fields
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use type=url / inputmode hints, associate labels, and report validation errors with aria-invalid plus a described-by message after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Certificate-hash field validates on change, sets aria-invalid and fills an aria-describedby error line; numeric fields use inputmode.

summary: Real getStats() inventory against every spec member, with the per-session stability invariant checked live; verified end to end against a local HTTP/3 server.
